t: You're on Abingdon Villas, a street in Kensington that runs roughly west to east, from Earls Court Road to Marloes Road. Along the way it crosses Abingdon Road and Allen Street. Two people are tied to it. Julia Trevelyan Oman was born here in 1930. She grew up to be a set designer, working in television, theatre, ballet and opera, and she was later made a Commander of the Order of the British Empire. Rita Favanti, a Victorian singer, died on this street in 1867.
